END_BEFORE_START: End must be after the start
ALREADY_STARTED: This term has already started. Pick a later one.
TOO_SOON: This time is too soon to book — earlier notice is required
TOO_FAR_AHEAD: This time cannot be booked more than {max} days in advance
OUTSIDE_WORKING_HOURS: The chosen time is outside the working hours. Choose a start and a length that end by closing time.
OWNER_NO_BANK_ACCOUNT: The owner has not configured a bank account for online payments
TOO_EARLY_FOR_NO_SHOW: Cannot mark no-show before the booking has started
INVALID_STATE: Booking is not in a valid state ({status})
TERM_NO_LONGER_AVAILABLE: Those dates were booked in the meantime — this can't be undone
PAYMENT_METHOD_REQUIRED: Choose a payment method — cash or online
GUEST_CANCELLATION_CLOSED: You can no longer cancel this booking yourself. Arrange the cancellation with the owner.
PAYMENT_ALREADY_REPORTED: You have already reported that this payment is not confirmed. An administrator is looking into it.
PAYMENT_DEADLINE_PASSED: The payment deadline has passed, so the payment can no longer be reported.
NO_SHOW_ALREADY_DISPUTED: You have already disputed the no-show mark. An administrator is looking into it.
STATE_CHANGED: The booking changed in the meantime, so this action is no longer possible.
SLOT_REQUIRED: Pick one of the offered time slots.
CHANGE_NOT_AVAILABLE: The term of this booking cannot be changed here right now. Agree it with the owner.
CHANGE_DEADLINE_PASSED: A change of term can be asked for until {hours} hours before the start. For a later change, contact the owner.
CHANGE_ALREADY_PENDING: You have already asked for another term. Wait for the owner to answer, or withdraw the request.
CHANGE_SAME_TERM: That is the term you already have. Choose another one.
CHANGE_TERM_TAKEN: The chosen term is taken. Choose another one.
CHANGE_TERM_NO_LONGER_FREE: The new term has been taken meanwhile, so the change cannot be approved. Reject the request or agree another term with the guest.
CHANGE_NOT_PENDING: There is no change of term waiting for an answer.
CHANGE_EXPIRED: The request for another term has expired because the term has started.
